query_evidence.question: ORACLE B3 for scenarios Q13
query_evidence.sql:
SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN typeof(r.raw_amount) IN ('integer','real') OR trim(r.raw_amount) GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(r.raw_amount AS REAL) END),2) AS raw_numeric_sum_reviewed,
 round(sum(t.amount_usd),2) AS curated_sum_reviewed,
 sum(NOT (typeof(r.raw_amount) IN ('integer','real') OR trim(r.raw_amount) GLOB '[0-9]*')) AS reviewed_non_numeric
FROM payment_quality_review q JOIN raw_payment_source r ON r.txn_id=q.txn_id JOIN transactions t ON t.txn_id=q.txn_id
